map.如何使用农业计算器？: How do I use Agriculture Calculator?
map.农业计算器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Agriculture Calculator best for?
map.涵盖肥料配比、种植密度、农药稀释、灌溉水量、孵化倒计时、农机油耗等常用农业计算: Covers common agricultural calculations: fertilizer blending, planting density, pesticide dilution, irrigation volume, hatching countdown, and machinery fuel use.
map.各元素用量 = 肥料总量 × (元素含量% / 100): Each nutrient amount = total fertilizer x (nutrient content % / 100)
map.肥料总量 = 面积 × 每亩用量；养分用量 = 总量 × 含量%；密度 = 1: Total fertilizer = area x per-mu dose; nutrient amount = total x content %; density = 1 / (plant spacing x row spacing); dilution factor = stock concentration / target concentration; irrigation volume = area x water depth; fuel use = worked area x per-mu fuel.
map.综合页含 6 组子计算器：① 肥料配比按「总量 = 面积 × 每亩用量」，氮/磷: The combined page has 6 sub-calculators: 1) Fertilizer blend uses "total = area x per-mu dose", N/P/K each by content %; 2) Planting density converts plant footprint via spacing x row; 3) Pesticide dilution gets the dilution factor from stock/target concentration ratio, then multiplies target water for dose; 4) Irrigation water converts area x depth (mm) to volume, scaled by efficiency to gross water; 5) Hatching countdown advances 21 days daily from set date; 6) Machinery fuel uses worked area x per-mu fuel, then cost by fuel price. Sub-items are independent and shown together in one result area.
map.株数 = 面积(m²) / (株距(m) × 行距(m)): Plant count = area (m²) / (plant spacing (m) x row spacing (m))
map.原药用量 = (目标浓度 × 配制药液量) / 原药浓度: Stock dose = (target concentration x prepared solution volume) / stock concentration
map.注意：配药时请穿戴防护装备，严格按照推荐浓度使用，避免药害或残留超标。: Note: wear protective gear when mixing, strictly follow the recommended concentration, and avoid phytotoxicity or excessive residue.
map.用水量(m³) = 面积(亩) × 灌溉深度(mm) × 0.667: Water use (m³) = area (mu) x irrigation depth (mm) x 0.667
map.，1mm水深 × 1亩 = 0.667m³: , 1 mm water depth x 1 mu = 0.667 m³
map.参考值：苗期灌溉深度一般 10-20mm，生长期 30-50mm，开花坐果期 4: Reference: seedling-stage depth 10-20 mm, growth stage 30-50 mm, flowering/fruiting stage 40-60 mm.
map.（鸡），入孵后自动计算各阶段进度: (chicken); after setting, each stage progresses automatically.
map.总油耗 = 作业面积 × 每亩油耗: Total fuel = worked area x per-mu fuel
map.总费用 = 总油耗 × 油价: Total cost = total fuel x fuel price
map.参考值：旋耕作业约 0.8-1.2 L/亩，播种约 0.5-0.8 L/亩，收割: Reference: rotary tillage ~0.8-1.2 L/mu, sowing ~0.5-0.8 L/mu, harvesting ~1.5-2.5 L/mu.
map.农业计算器是一款专为农民、农业技术人员和种植户设计的多功能在线计算工具，涵盖施肥: Agriculture Calculator is a multi-function online tool designed for farmers, agronomists and growers, covering six scenarios: fertilization, planting, irrigation, pest control, livestock, and machinery operation.
map.本页提供 6 个独立小工具：肥料配方折算、种植密度、农药稀释、灌溉用水量、孵化参: This page provides 6 independent mini-calculators: fertilizer formula conversion, planting density, pesticide dilution, irrigation water volume, incubation parameters, and machinery fuel use.
map.肥料面板按 N-P-K 比例与目标用量折算单质肥；农药面板按有效成分含量折算原药: The fertilizer panel converts N-P-K ratios and target rates into straight fertilizers; the pesticide panel converts active-ingredient content into product amount and dilution ratio.
map.种植密度面板按株距×行距折算每亩株数；灌溉面板按「面积×灌水深度×0.667」折: The density panel converts plant spacing x row spacing into plants per mu; the irrigation panel converts area x irrigation depth x 0.667 into water volume.
map.目标浓度 1000 ppm、配药液量 30 L、原药有效成分 40% ⇒ 原药用: Target 1000 ppm, spray volume 30 L, product active ingredient 40% => product amount = 1000 ppm x 30 L / 40% = 75 g (1 ppm ~ 1 mg/L, so 1000 ppm = 1 g/L). Always verify concentration and pre-harvest interval on the product label.
map.说明：本页不提供「投入产出/净收益」测算。若需估算净收益，请另行用「产量 × 单: Note: this page does not provide an input-output/net-return calculator. To estimate net return, calculate yield x price - cost manually or use a dedicated break-even tool; do not treat these 6 calculators as a profit model.
map.肥料面板的 N-P-K 比例怎么填？: How do I fill the N-P-K ratio in the fertilizer panel?
map.按目标配方中各养分占纯养分的百分比填写，如 15-15-15 表示 N 15%、: Enter each nutrient as a percentage of pure nutrients, e.g. 15-15-15 means N 15%, P2O5 15%, K2O 15%; the tool then converts to product amounts using the active content of urea/superphosphate/potassium chloride.
map.农药稀释按有效成分还是制剂？: Does pesticide dilution use active ingredient or product?
map.本页按制剂的「有效成分含量%」折算原药用量，ppm 指百万分之一，1 ppm ≈: This page converts product amount from the product's active-ingredient percentage; ppm means parts per million, 1 ppm ~ 1 mg/L. Always follow the concentration and pre-harvest interval on the label.
